reply.text: {"say":"Push day built for a garage gym: a barbell bench leads, then an overhead press, a dumbbell incline for upper chest, and triceps to finish.","title":"Garage Gym Push Day","days":[{"name":"Push","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"pause lightly at the chest"},{"key":"barbell-overhead-press","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"brace hard, full lockout"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline"},{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"slight bend in elbows"},{"key":"barbell-skull-crusher","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"elbows stay pointed up"},{"key":"dumbbell-triceps-kickback","sets":2,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"squeeze at lockout"}]}],"unmet":[]}
